gloss: immigration and emigration; entry and exit of a country

definitions.gloss: immigration and emigration; entering and leaving a country
definitions.explanation: The process of entering and exiting a country, encompassing passport control, visa checks, and border procedures. Commonly encountered at airports and ports.

examples.japanese: {出入国|しゅつにゅうこく}{審査|しんさ}に{並|なら}んだ。
examples.english: I lined up for immigration inspection.

examples.japanese: {出入国|しゅつにゅうこく}{管理|かんり}が{厳|きび}しくなっている。
{空港|くうこう}の{出入国|しゅつにゅうこく}{手続|てつづ}きは{自動化|じどうか}が{進|すす}んでいる。
examples.english: Automated systems are increasingly being used for airport immigration procedures.

examples.japanese: {出入国|しゅつにゅうこく}カードに{必要|ひつよう}{事項|じこう}を{記入|きにゅう}してください。
examples.english: Please fill in the required information on the immigration card.

notes:
Compound of {出国|しゅっこく} (leaving a country) + {入国|にゅうこく} (entering a country). In practice, the combined form {出入国|しゅつにゅうこく} is used when referring to border control processes as a whole.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出入国|しゅつにゅうこく}{管理|かんり}: immigration control
- {出入国|しゅつにゅうこく}{審査|しんさ}: immigration inspection
- {出入国|しゅつにゅうこく}{手続|てつづ}き: immigration procedures
- {出入国|しゅつにゅうこく}カード: arrival/departure card
- {出入国|しゅつにゅうこく}{在留|ざいりゅう}{管理庁|かんりちょう}: Immigration Services Agency of Japan

USAGE:
The full official name of Japan's immigration authority is {出入国|しゅつにゅうこく}{在留|ざいりゅう}{管理庁|かんりちょう} (Immigration Services Agency), often abbreviated as {入管|にゅうかん}. Signs at airports typically read {出入国|しゅつにゅうこく}{審査|しんさ} (Immigration) or {入国|にゅうこく}{審査|しんさ}.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {入国|にゅうこく}: entering a country — one direction only (arrival)
- {出国|しゅっこく}: leaving a country — one direction only (departure)
- {渡航|とこう}: overseas travel — broader concept covering the journey itself
